verdict.rationale: The product is a skill and plugin pack. It does not ship its own assistant, but it lets users delegate concrete tasks to their host agent through slash commands. Documented examples include building a spec test-first, splitting specs into agent-buildable tickets, reviewing diffs, diagnosing bugs and resolving merge conflicts, running in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Copilot. Missing for 10: a genuinely built-in assistant (it relies on an external agent), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the delegated workflows work as described.
